Plants perform photosynthesis (requiring chloroplasts) and cellular respiration (requiring mitochondria). Fungi and animals do not have chloroplasts but do have mitochondria for cellular respiration.  
Option (A) is false because plants have mitochondria.  
Option (B) is false because plants have mitochondria.  
Option (C) is false because fungi do not have chloroplasts.  
Option (D) is consistent with known biology: plants have both organelles; animals and fungi have only mitochondria.  

Final answer: (D)
